note: Qualitative external conditions. They correspond to the Street Slice's rain / heat modes. Values are scenario assumptions, not forecasts.

scenarios.label: Heavy rain
scenarios.description: A short, intense summer downpour on normally moist ground.

scenarios.label: Hot summer day
scenarios.description: Strong sun and high air temperature; soils hold a normal amount of water.

scenarios.label: Hot day in a drought
scenarios.description: The same heat, after weeks without rain: little water is left in the soil.
